{{Top|leg}}
A '''Je'daii''' was a member of the [[Je'daii Order]], an organization of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] which existed millennia before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The term "Je'daii" could apply to members of any rank. They focused on maintaining a balance in the Force.<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi 0>[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>

The Je'daii saw the Force as two aspects of a whole: the Ashla ([[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]) and the Bogan ([[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]]).<ref name="Force Storm 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>
